text:
Alice Ng: Morning — quick async standup for the canary ramp. I kicked off feature flag slice42 to 2% at 06:10PT. Need a latency and error check before we move to 10% later today.
Ben (infra): Saw the canary in the dashboard. p50 is fine, p99 spiked from 420ms -> 620ms for a short window around 06:14. No increase in CPU on hosts.
Carmen: I validated inference SLOs against the smoke prompts. Output quality looks intact. No hallucination regressions so far.
David R: I pulled logs for that timeframe — a few 502s from gateway to runtime (3 total, all within 2m). Tracing shows a short reconnect with the KV cache. Investigating.
Alice Ng: Thanks. David, can you post the trace IDs when you have them? I'll hold the 10% ramp until we confirm.
Ben (infra): trace ids: trace-9a2b, trace-9a2c. Also noticed one host had slightly higher GC during the spike (G1 pause ~80ms). Might be unrelated but filing infra ticket.
Carmen: Noted. I can run a quick rerun of the failing prompt set against the canary model and baseline. Will report back in ~15m.
David R: trace-9a2b correlates with a retry loop in the runtime: "WARN kvcache: reconnect attempt 3" — looks like transient network blip. No OOMs.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout event: slice42 -> 2% (initiated by Alice Ng) — 2024-08-17T13:10:05Z
Alice Ng: Okay, plan: wait for Carmen's quality check + Ben to confirm infra ticket. If no further 5xxs and p99 drops back under 500ms for 10m, we'll ramp to 10% at 09:40PT.
Ben (infra): I opened INFRA-812: investigate GC twitch on host gpu-3. Added logs and pinned the suspicious host. Will roll out a patch if we see recurrence.
Carmen: Ran the prompt set against canary and stable. Diff summary: 0 high-severity regressions, 2 minor formatting deviations (expected). Sample outputs attached to the ticket.
David R: Still seeing occasional reconnect logs but frequency down to 1/min. No new 502s in the last 12m.
Alice Ng: Great. I'll set a scheduled reminder at 09:35PT to check again. If anything changes, ping @channel.
Ben (infra): thumbs up :+1: Also setting an alert to auto-notify if p99 > 600ms for >3m.
Carmen: If we do ramp to 10% I'll toggle the cache-prefetch flag to on for the slice — should reduce cold KV hits.
David R: Agree. Leave canary metrics collection enabled (trace sampling at 100%) for another hour.
Alice Ng: Summary: hold for now, Carmen + Ben + David to monitor. Target ramp to 10% at 09:40PT if metrics good. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
Ben (infra): ping me if you want me to pause the rollout midway.
Carmen: I will add my validation notes to the rollout doc.
David R: tagging INFRA-812 and ROLLOUT-542 in the thread for traceability.
Alice Ng: closing the loop — will post final decision after 09:35PT check.
